claims: Major League Baseball (MLB) celebrated the 79th anniversary of Jackie Robinson breaking the color barrier on April 15, 2026.
All players and coaches wore No. 42 on April 15, 2026.
The Los Angeles Dodgers and New York Mets held a ceremony at the Jackie Robinson statue in Centerfield Plaza at Dodger Stadium.
The Los Angeles Dodgers Foundation (LADF) honored their LADF/Jackie Robinson Foundation (JRF) scholars and alumni with a special career panel.
The Jackie Robinson Museum hosted activities throughout the weekend.
The Jackie Robinson Museum hosted "Robinson's Readers: Story Time and Craft" for kids.
The 2026 Jackie Robinson Day occurred on April 15, 2026.
The 2026 Jackie Robinson Day is the 79th anniversary of Jackie Robinson's debut in 1947.
